npcs.name: Bird Watcher
lines: I saw a big bird circling the trees near the forest gatehouse...
It landed somewhere off the trail. Go slowly, it spooks easily.

npcs.name: Bug Catcher
lines: I came to catch bugs, but today there's only Pidgey and Rattata.
The tall grass beside the road is full of them. Clever little critters!
That cave to the east is Diglett's Cave. It runs under the entire region.

signs.name: SquareSign
signs.title: Sign
lines: WEST: VIRIDIAN FOREST  /  EAST: DIGLETT'S CAVE
